details.biography:
Jacob's Well · Seat 4, Ranged

The Silver Tower sent you to Veradyna to catalogue the old magic of the frontier, and the Keepers were the only escort going north. You find the cold, the food and the company equally trying. You are very good, and you know it.

Tonight: Somewhere in this fort there is magic you can feel but not see.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Spellcasting. Intelligence. Spell save DC 14, 15 for Conjuration (School Focus). Slots: 5 cantrips, four 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells from your spellbook each morning. You cannot cast in armour or with a shield. See the spell page.

Arcane Recovery. Once a day, after 10 minutes of study, regain spent slots totalling up to 2 spell levels.

Scribe's Insight. Once a day, as part of casting a spell, swap one prepared spell for another of the same level from your spellbook.

School Focus: Conjuration. +1 to the save DC of your Conjuration spells (Grease, Web, Glitterdust).

Steady Focus (feat, 1st). Advantage on saves to keep a spell you are casting, or concentration, when damaged, shoved or forced to react. Once per encounter, turn one such failed save into a success.

Kit: Silver Tower Scholar. Elemental Precision: once per encounter, a spell you cast that deals elemental damage gives the target Disadvantage on its save. Aldorethi Theory: Advantage recalling Aldorethi magical theory or history.

High Elf. Trance (4 hours rests you). Keen Senses: Advantage on sight and hearing Perception. Arcane Sense: you feel significant magical auras within 60ft and their rough direction, no check. Extra cantrip (Read Magic). Weapon training: longsword, shortsword, longbow, rapier.

Casting

Also in your spellbook: Sleep, Grease, Burning Hands, Comprehend Languages (1st).

Armour Class on the sheet: Dex +2. 15 with Mage Armour (8 hours)

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane spells per the Spells Per Day table, plus Bonus Spells from high Intelligence.

Scribe's Insight

  • Effect: Once per day, as part of casting a spell, swap one prepared spell for a different spell of the same level from your spellbook — the methodical, bookish caster rewriting their working memory on the fly.

School Focus

  • Effect: Choose one school of magic (see Spellcasting in Arneyan). The save DC of your spells of that school is increased by 1.

2nd Level

Arcane Recovery

  • Effect: Once per day, after 10 minutes of study, regain expended spell slots with a combined level up to half your Wizard level (rounded up). None may be above 5th level.

6th Level

Cantrip Expertise

  • Effect: Add your Intelligence modifier (minimum 0) to the damage of your damaging cantrips. Does not stack with the Cantrip Mastery feat.

13th Level

Detect Magic

  • Effect: After 5 rounds of study, an Intelligence check reveals the magical origin of an item whose kind of magic you have met before.
  • From 18th level it also reveals the item's power and history

15th Level

  • Intelligence Bonus: permanent +1 Intelligence

17th Level

Counterspell

  • Effect: Once per encounter, when a creature within 60ft casts a spell no higher in level than half your Wizard level, you may try to counter it as your reaction, using no slot: an Intelligence check against its save DC makes it fizzle, and a failure spends the attempt.

18th Level

Signature Spells

  • Effect: Choose two spells of 3rd level or lower from your spellbook. You can cast each once per day at its level without expending a slot.

20th Level

Perfect Recall

  • Effect: Recall a previously-cast 1st-level spell once per day via an Intelligence check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot.
  • From 24th level: works for previously-cast 2nd-level spells

Kits — Arneyan Arcane Traditions

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Wizard folder. Drag one onto your character.

Wizard Kits represent the institution, tradition, or circumstance that trained the character in the arcane arts.

Wizard Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Intelligence 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the wizard is high enough level to cast that spell tier at all.

Size Medium • Speed 30ft • Low-Light Vision (not true darkvision) • +2 Dex / +1 Int, −1 Con

Traits

  • Immune to magical sleep.
  • Advantage on saves vs charm.
  • Trance (4hr rest instead of 8hr sleep).
  • Keen Senses: Advantage on Perception checks (sight or hearing) and on concentration saves to maintain spells.
  • Armour training: light.

Subtypes

  • High Elf: weapon training (longsword/shortsword/longbow/rapier), one Wizard cantrip at creation, Arcane Sense (innately sense the presence and rough direction of significant magical auras or arcane sites — wards, ley-adjacent places, active enchantments — within 60ft, no check required).
  • Saevren (Wood Elf): weapon training (longbow/shortbow/shortsword/handaxe), +5ft speed, Advantage on Stealth/Perception in natural environments, Camouflage (1/long rest, as part of your movement while in natural terrain: become undetectable to passive notice until you move or act).
  • Iiria Elf (Jinia coastal): weapon training (shortsword/longbow/spear/net), Advantage on checks/saves involving navigation/sailing/coastal environments, Advantage on Perception at sea or on coastlines, Sea Legs (1/long rest: reroll a failed Reflex save while aboard a vessel or in open water).

system.description:
A blow lands, the ground shifts, someone grabs at you mid-casting — and the working holds anyway. You have Advantage on saves made to keep a spell you are casting, or to maintain concentration on one, when you take damage, are shoved or are otherwise forced to react mid-cast. Once per encounter, you may turn one such failed save into a success.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
